mechanism: A probabilistic source-exemplar teacher, weighted by rare exact agreement under a field-copy/null model, addresses observed source joint retention beyond within-segment independent resampling. This is a hypothesis; it does not establish the real synthesis mechanism.
novelty: Previous source nearest-neighbor normalized-L1 averages and domain-density/covariate PMI failed. Here the weights are estimated by unsupervised EM with per-field background probabilities, a null component and all same-distance source rows; no nearest-k or uniform label average.
source_data_policy: Same audited CC0 source129859; exclude21 exact matches to any official train/test feature vector regardless of labels. No new data, dependencies or credentials. Source target enters posterior teacher only after matching weights fit on outer-training/source covariates. Official targets only fit main supervised LGB.
